title: Reliability Specialist
description:
Overview

Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We're proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell's brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao's Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder's of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Responsibilities

Maintenance Reliability Specialist

How you will make history here..

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Reliability Specialist to join our team in the food manufacturing industry. This role is tailored for professionals with a foundational understanding of maintenance, ideally within a bakery or food production setting. This position is responsible for implementing advanced reliability tools, work processes, and supporting reliability efforts for the plant. They will work to improve equipment and process performance by applying reliability principles, statistical data analysis and supporting the work process to support the Company's overall strategic objectives with a focus on safety, people, quality, delivery and cost.

What you will do

  • The Reliability Specialist will focus on addressing recurrent issues impacting plant efficiency and profitability, fostering a proactive approach to eliminating downtime and improving machinery performance.
  • Identify and manage asset reliability risks through loss elimination, risk and Life Cycle Asset Management
  • Analyze root causes of recurring issues affecting equipment performance and plant efficiency.
  • Develop and implement effective solutions to minimize downtime and enhance throughput in the manufacturing process.
  • Conduct an analysis of reliability problems to determine what reliability tools are required for the particular situation.
  • Collaborate with maintenance personnel and production teams to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
  • Monitor equipment performance metrics and recommend best practices to improve reliability and operational performance.
  • Document and communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, promoting continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the implementation of preventative maintenance strategies to mitigate potential disruptions.
  • 75% - Reliability/Project Management:
    • Develops engineering solutions to repetitive failures and all other problems that adversely affect plant operations.
    • Utilize data analysis techniques that can include statistical process control; reliability modeling and prediction; Six Sigma methodology; root cause failure analysis (RCFA); and corrective and preventative actions systems.
    • Delivers a through timely, cost-effective implementation to optimize operational effectiveness and efficiency.
    • Participate in the design and installation, scheduling and capital funds of cost-effective equipment modifications to help improve safety, reliability, and throughput.
    • Provides active technical support for all plant departments, to drive performance objectives and improvement initiatives.
  • 25% - Strategic Partner:
    • Provide ongoing leadership for Lean transformation and other continuous improvement initiatives. Actively participate in and help drive the 5S Program, kaizen events, standard work development, etc.
    • Considers the impact of costs during the design phase or remedial action for correcting reliability problems on installed equipment and performs root cause analysis to help prevent failures.
    • Participates in final check-out of new installations. This includes factory and site acceptance testing that will assure adherence to functional specifications.

Who you will work with

  • Reporting into our Director of Site Operations and our Maintenance Manager

Qualifications

What you bring to the table... (Must Have)

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2.5+ years of reliability/maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment.

It would be great if you have... (Nice to Have)

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred
  • 3+ years of reliability/maintenance experience within food manufacturing
  • PLC experience

Compensation and Benefits

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between $74,700-$107,400. Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.

Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We are a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. Our mission is to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

About us:

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Construction and Projects Overview

Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our stores, distribution centers and headquarters. Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading-edge design, development, construction, and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place on one of our Properties teams and help us make the most of Target’s physical assets, both in the U.S. and overseas.

A role in Construction means leading the execution of store and distribution center projects. From large program rollouts to unique special projects, or large ground-up construction, you’ll help manage the scope, schedule, and budget for all Target construction projects, including adhering to the project timeline, coordinating, and overseeing the onsite construction process and turnover. You’ll keep all the players and partners aligned with effective communication between vendors, general contractors, field leadership, and project teams.

Lead Estimator Role

As a Lead Estimator you will develop accurate estimates to support capital investment strategies. Evaluate actual vs. estimated costs on all applicable projects and generate cost analysis to make informed decisions based on various implementation strategies. Respond efficiently to cost requests from multiple cross functional groups. Develop conceptual and feasibility cost estimates to help leaders make informed decisions. Develop and update model budgets for various types of projects by evaluating design information, historical costs, market conditions and project schedules. Participate in value engineering analysis and provide project team with cost-saving design alternatives. Responsibilities will also include bid review analysis, create project comparisons, and perform change order review. Generate scope of work narratives and assumptions for all estimates. Facilitate meetings and present estimates to internal clients and cross functional project teams. Maintain market knowledge regarding costs through regular review of industry resources and maintaining strong relationships with general contractors and vendors. Visit project sites as necessary (less than 10% travel).

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

About You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, Construction Management, or related field

  • Minimum 5 years of full-time commercial construction estimating experience.

  • Highly proficient in Excel/Microsoft Office/On-Screen Take-off/Bluebeam or equivalent software.

  • Technical competency in conceptual/cost model/detailed type estimating, schematic, and design development estimates.

  • Capable of performing quantity take-offs for offsite, onsite, and building trades. Skilled in interpreting construction documents, ESA, and geotechnical reports.

Job Title: AI Engineer (Search Engine)

About the Company: Insight Global's Client

  • CLT ONLY ( This cannot change to PJ)

title: Video Editor For Science & Paleontology Youtube Channel
description:
Overview

I'm looking for a video editor who specializes in long-form content. This would be a full-time position to edit videos for a YouTube channel that specializes in educational content (think TierZoo). We need someone who is proficient in editing, able to do simple to moderately complex graphics / animations, and able to adapt their style to match our video’s style.

It is crucial that you have a strong grasp of the English language, as our videos are primarily about paleontology. Being able to understand scientific terminology and doing some research is a must. If paleontology and science in general are personal interests of yours, then this role will be perfect for you.

The process of the job is that we provide you with a script and audio that matches the script, and then it will be your role to find supporting images, videos, and create short motion graphics when applicable. The videos and images will be sourced from studies, documentaries, Wikipedia / Wikimedia, art websites (DeviantArt, ArtStation, etc.), and studies, so being able to Google proficiently is very important. Our video upload schedule is around 1 long-form video a week (between 20–30 minutes in length).

Responsibilities

To qualify for this position you need to be :

  • Experienced video editor (experience with motion graphics and simple 2D animations)
  • Highly proficient in English
  • Proficient in research
  • Fast and diligent learner, always looking to improve and willing to take the time to understand things like scientific concepts in order to best add value to the video
  • Organized and punctual with delivery
  • Able to learn from feedback (I do not want to provide the same feedback every time without change)
  • Not afraid to ask questions
  • Comfortable using whichever professional video editing tools you prefer

Growth and Compensation

This is a position that can grow as the channel(s) grow over time, meaning that this job can evolve and change. Compensation is per minute edited, with the number depending on time and proficiency.

To show that you read this whole description, include the phrase "I like dinosaurs" in your response, along with anything else you want.

How to apply

To apply, please reach out and consider sending the 1 video you’re most proud of that best shows your applicable talents.

Questions to answer in your reach-out

  1. Where are you from?
  2. How many hours a week can you commit to this?
  3. What was your last video editing experience?

title: Social Media/ Marketing Strategist
description:
Overview

Description removed for clarity. This role is a Marketing Strategist focused on growing the Partner Company’s presence in Brooklyn and Chicago through social media, content, and digital advertising.

Work Arrangement

Work Arrangement : Fully remote, overlapping EST working hours.

Job Type

Job Type : Full-time

Work Schedule

Work Schedule : 40 hours per week, with core hours between 10 AM – 6 PM EST

Locations

Locations : Remote, open to candidates globally.

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. They’re looking for the sharpest, hungriest candidates who they can consistently promote and work with over many years. Candidates we’ve hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.

Why Work with Us?

We’re not just another recruiting firm - we focus on placing candidates with exceptional US and EU founders who prioritize the long-term success of their team members. We also provide retention bonuses at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months, as well as community-driven benefits like an annual retreat.

About the Company

The Partner Company offers a unique blend of shuffleboard fun, tropical vibes, and events in Brooklyn and Chicago. They’re looking to grow their digital presence with engaging, location-specific content and targeted advertising to drive foot traffic, event attendance, and brand loyalty.

Role Overview

As a Marketing Strategist, you’ll drive the online presence of the Partner's Company at Brooklyn and Chicago locations through engaging social media content and targeted advertising. You'll own content strategy and community management across Instagram and TikTok, run Google Ads campaigns, and track performance to inform future creative and strategic decisions. This is a high-impact role for someone who is equal parts creative and analytical, thrives in fast-paced environments, and understands what drives engagement in the hospitality and lifestyle space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Social Media Management :
    • Develop and execute monthly content calendars tailored to each venue’s unique personality and audience.
    • Collaborate remotely with venue managers and staff to coordinate on-site content capture (photos and short-form video).
    • Create content aligned with trending formats, memes, pop culture, and community interests.
    • Manage daily community engagement, responding to comments, DMs, and sharing user-generated content.
    • Maintain brand tone and consistency across all social channels.
  • Digital Advertising & Analytics :
    • Plan, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns for events, leagues, and brand awareness.
    • Manage boosted posts and paid campaigns on Instagram and TikTok.
    • Track and report on key performance indicators including reach, engagement, conversions, and ROI.
    • Deliver clear monthly performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Creative Innovation & Brand Growth :
    • Propose and test new content series or campaign ideas each quarter.
    • Stay on top of social media trends to keep the brand’s content fresh and relevant.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal marketing and event teams to align messaging and objectives.

Requirements

Must-Have :

  • 2–4 years of overall professional experience, with at least 1–2 years directly managing Instagram, TikTok, and Google Ads for hospitality, entertainment, or lifestyle brands.
  • Strong understanding of current social media trends, meme culture, and visual storytelling.
  • Hands-on experience with social media scheduling tools.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into strategy.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with remote and in-person teams.
  • Strong time-management skills; able to juggle multiple priorities and locations independently.
  • Portfolio or clear case studies showcasing successful campaigns and measurable results.
  • Nice-to-Have :
    • Content creation skills (e.g., video editing, basic design using Canva or Adobe Suite).
    • Experience coordinating or working directly with event-based marketing.
    • Familiarity with TikTok’s creator tools and Instagram Reels best practices.
    • Background in hospitality, nightlife, or entertainment environments.
    • Passion for fun, community-focused spaces.

KPIs & Success Metrics

  • Engagement Rate : Improve average likes, comments, shares, and saves across platforms.
  • Follower Growth : Achieve consistent growth on both Instagram and TikTok.
  • Content Output : Publish 2–3 posts per week per platform, plus stories and reels.
  • Community Management : Respond to 100% of messages and comments within 24 business hours.
  • Ad Performance : Meet or exceed industry benchmarks on CTR, conversions, and ROAS.
  • Event Uplift : Demonstrate increased attendance or signups linked to campaigns.
  • Reporting : Deliver clear, strategic performance reports monthly.
  • Innovation : Launch at least one new content series or idea every quarter.

Benefits

Compensation Package

  • Competitive Salary : Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work : Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Generous PTO : Ample paid time off to rest and recharge
  • Direct Mentorship : Grow through guidance from international industry experts

  • Global Networking : Work and connect with professionals around the world
  • Work-Life Balance : Flexible hours that support a healthy work-life balance

A day in the life:

As a Landing Page Strategist, you’ll play a critical role in executing and optimizing high-performing landing pages that drive real business results across lead generation, paid media, and eCommerce campaigns.You’ll work closely with senior strategists, paid media teams, lifecycle marketers, account managers, and creatives to support the day-to-day management of our clients’ landing page programs. This includes strategic planning, copywriting, QA, stakeholder communication, A/B testing, reporting, and ongoing optimization.This is a client-facing, detail-oriented role ideal for someone with a passion for conversion strategy, digital marketing, and performance design. You’ll gain deep hands-on experience across the entire landing page lifecycle while helping execute and grow one of our most impactful service lines.

Responsibilities:

Client Execution & Project Management

  • Own the execution of landing page deliverables across strategy, copywriting, design feedback, development handoff, QA, and launch
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for internal teams and assist with client communication when needed
  • Translate paid media strategy and campaign briefs into high-converting landing page experiences
  • Work within structured workflows and project management tools (e.g., Asana) to track deliverables and meet timelines
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, and Development teams to align messaging, offers, and user experience
  • Assist in developing and refining landing page strategies that align with funnel stages and campaign goals
  • Conduct CRO audits, scroll map/click map reviews, and post-launch performance analysis to surface insights and optimizations
  • Support A/B testing strategy creation, execution, and reporting
  • Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design
  • Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred)..
  • Portfolio of work examples with proven results
  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc
  • Experience working with design platforms like Figma
  • Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Implement AI-driven automation 50%+ of landing page workflows.
  • On-time delivery of landing page milestones (strategy, copy, QA, launch)
  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback
  • A/B testing velocity and learnings logged

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Execute Flawlessly Across the Landing Page Lifecycle – Deliver end-to-end execution across strategy, copy, QA, and launch
  • Drive Conversion-Focused Results – Apply best practices and insights to improve performance and meet client goals
  • Collaborate Across Teams – Serve as the operational glue between Paid, Lifecycle, Creative, and Dev teams
  • Grow Through Process and Learning – Support the growth of the landing page program through repeatable systems and continuous improvement

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD

  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities

title: Pre-Award Specialist
description:
Overview

University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

Department: Cancer Center

Working Title: Pre-Award Specialist

Position #: – Requisition #: 37750

Job Summary:

The Oncology Clinical Research Pre Award Specialist is responsible for developing, negotiating, finalizing and reviewing budgets for clinical trials conducted by faculty members of the University of Colorado Cancer Center at University of Colorado Hospital (UCH). This position requires discretion, analytical skill and personal responsibility to identify, research, collaborate and creatively solve problems in a changing environment while remaining within system, institutional, and state fiscal policies. This position works extensively with industry sponsors, CU finance contacts, clinical staff, faculty members, the University of Colorado Hospital, administrative staff throughout the University, as well as representatives from various departments and CU Medicine. A lot of training is provided up front as this position must learn a Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA), oncology clinical trial protocols, and processes and procedures of the oncology clinical trial Post Award specialist, the oncology clinical trial finance/billing specialist, and clinic staff.

Job trainings and functions include reviewing and analyzing complex oncology clinical trial protocols, drafting a study-specific budget to account for all procedural and labor costs, working with the clinical trial system OnCoreTM, calendar builders and Project/Research managers to ensure all costs are properly accounted for. This position is responsible for contracts/ grants solicitation and administration, grant/agreement preparation, review and negotiation, regulatory compliance, sponsor communication and pre-award management. This position will have budgetary oversight and is responsible for the advancement of oncology clinical trial contracts and amendments sponsored by industry, cooperative groups, federal grants/contracts and investigator initiated clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities

Specific Examples of Work Performed (All Levels):

  • Review clinical trial protocols in order to draft a study-specific budget that accounts for all procedural and labor costs.

  • Negotiate budgets with industry sponsors.

  • Review and negotiate contractual payment terms.

  • Work with the Clinical Research Administration Office (CRAO) to review and approve final contracts (budget related sections and exhibits).

  • Work with OnCoreTM calendar builders to ensure financial information in OnCoreTM accurately reflects procedures, rates and prices in the negotiated budgets.

  • Review contractual documents to ensure final negotiated terms have been incorporated.

  • Route contractual documents for non-budget increase amendments.

  • Collaborate with Finance Specialists, Regulatory Affairs and Clinical Coordinators to ensure the negotiated budget terms are understood and billed correctly.

  • Complete pre-award reviews using OnCoreTM and train other finance team members in this task if required.

Additional Duties for Level II:

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Work with Clinical Project Managers and demonstrate advanced research budgeting knowledge.

Additional Duties for Level III:

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in the clinical trials management software OnCoreTM.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget management and negotiation.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Act as resource to assist other Clinical Research Budget Specialists as needed.

  • Identify process improvement opportunities and involve others across interrelated teams to evaluate.

Work Location

Remote – this role is eligible to work remotely, but the employee must be in the United States.

Why Join Us

The University of Colorado Cancer Center stands at the forefront of cancer research and patient care in Colorado. As the state's only National Cancer Institute (NCI) designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, we hold a prestigious distinction recognizing our contributions to research, clinical trials, prevention, and cancer control. Our guiding vision is to prevent and conquer cancer, together. Our mission is to unite our community to overcome cancer through innovation, discovery, prevention, early detection, multidisciplinary care, and education.

We have more than 300 members, including physicians and researchers, who conduct patient-centered research to develop innovative technologies and treatments. We also employ nearly 300 staff members who help expand the reach of the CU Cancer Center. Our expertise across cancer types enables world-class treatment and hope for patients with difficult cancers.

Why work for the University?

We offer amazing benefits, including generous holiday, vacation and sick leave. The University of Colorado offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical: Multiple plan options

  • Dental: Multiple plan options

  • Additional Insurance: Disability, Life, Vision

  • Retirement 401(a) Plan: Employer contributes 10% of gross pay

  • Paid Time Off: Accruals over the year

  • Vacation Days: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)

  • Sick Days: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)

  • Holiday Days: 10/year

  • Tuition Benefit: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses

  • ECO Pass: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

There are many additional perks and programs with CU Advantage.

To see what benefits are available, please visit:

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I (Entry):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist II (Intermediate):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Two (2) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist III (Senior):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Three (3) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Substitutions for all levels: Related experience in budget, finance, business administration or clinical field may substitute for the degree on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications for Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I:

  • Experience working with clinical trials management software, preferably OnCoreTM

  • One (1) or more years’ experience in a clinical or clinical research setting.

  • Six (6) months or more experience reading and understanding clinical research protocols, specifically oncology, is preferred.

  • Experience managing budgets.

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

All Levels:

  • Good comprehension of contract terminology and ability to draft and negotiate contract budget terms.

  • Ability to work across different departments.

  • Organizational skills, ability to multi-task, adapt to change, and handle competing priorities.

  • Financial analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot problems and pursue resolutions.

  • Critical thinking and decision-making with strong attention to detail.

  • Logical thinking with the ability to learn and process large amounts of information.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with medical and clinical research budgeting concepts.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

For full consideration, please submit the following documents:

1. A letter of interest describing relevant job experiences as they relate to listed job qualifications (use if a cover letter is necessary)

2. Curriculum vitae / Resume

3. Three to five professional references with contact details

title: Página da Vaga | Analista Governança e Controle Pleno - VMO | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura
description:
Job description

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

O Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) da Globo tem a missão de viabilizar e agregar valor às operações da empresa. Com uma grande diversidade de escopos e de colaboradores (são mais de 1.700), é natural que tenha um desafio de governança.

Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG.

Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos.

O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo.

Main responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor.
  • Elabora, define e dissemina metodologias e ferramentas que apoiem o gerenciamento de projetos nas áreas e projetos estratégicos da diretoria, sempre alinhado com as últimas tendências.
  • Apoia a interface com outras áreas envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área.
  • Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados.

No ciclo orçamentário de projetos

  • Levanta e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios.
  • Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo.
  • Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas.
  • Consolida o orçamento de projetos dos departamentos e elabora apresentação para defesa do planejamento do CSC para os próximos anos.

Na gestão de OKRs:

  • Conduz e reporta o andamento dos OKRs estratégicos do CSC e táticos de Governança e Controle.
  • Conduz o processo de definição, acompanhamento e revisão de OKRs, alinhados à estratégia da organização.
  • Facilita workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com lideranças e pontos focais.

No apoio à medição e melhoria de processos e tarefas:

  • Analisa gaps, tendências e desvios, propondo e/ou cobrando planos de ação para correções de rumo.
  • Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio de relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios.

No apoio à gestão:

  • Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento.

Requirements and skills

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou correlatas.
  • Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel (intermediário/avançado).
  • Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Visão analítica, ser interessado, proativo, organizado e com energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Gestão e melhoria contínua de processos (PDCA, DMAIC, ferramenta Bizagi);
  • Automação de processos. Ex: VBA no Excel, Power Automate no Microsoft 365;
  • Certificações como PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma ou similares;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com estrutura de VMO ou PMO;
  • Usuário de ferramenta de controle de projetos (PPM). Ex: ERP Oracle, Jira, Clarity PPM, Primavera;
  • Programação no Power BI;
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio.

Additional information

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo

Job title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About Innodata

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for many large technology companies and leading firms across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform improvements to AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts that assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete an English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

description:
Job description

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, e como organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento na assistência social e na área educacional. Essa variedade de atividades consolida a SPDM como uma grande instituição filantrópica, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Assim, a SPDM contribui efetivamente para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando garantir universalidade e acesso à saúde, essenciais ao desenvolvimento humano e social. Para isso, combina tecnologia de ponta com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, apoiado por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde então, busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, ampliar e consolidar os serviços de saúde oferecidos pelo SUS.

O programa tem como objetivo melhorar indicadores e a qualidade de vida da população, pautando-se pelos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com uma visão estratégica de gestão de serviços de saúde, através de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Periodicamente, publica anúncios recrutando esses profissionais nos principais jornais de São Paulo e municípios onde possui unidades.

Missão

Promover ações de saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços de saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis de assistência, garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Main responsibilities

Organizar a operação do serviço de enfermagem, garantir o bom andamento dos serviços, orientar pacientes, controlar salas, equipamentos e leitos disponíveis, além de orientar a equipe técnica.

Atender às normativas do COREN, garantir o cumprimento de rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS, prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário desde a admissão, acompanhar o atendimento técnico, atuar como facilitador nos processos de enfermagem, promover melhorias no processo assistencial, manter comunicação com o corpo clínico, garantir assistência humanizada e segura, promover treinamentos, auxiliar na certificação profissional, gerir notificações de não conformidades, controlar estoque de materiais, preencher registros específicos, assegurar uso adequado de equipamentos, atender às normas de biossegurança, participar de ações de parceria com instituições de ensino, apoiar o desenvolvimento de estagiários e residentes, e cumprir as políticas de conduta e LGPD da instituição.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem
  • Especialização em Urgência e/ou Emergência
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na função de enfermeiro em urgência/emergência, em UPAs ou CER
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 19h, carga horária de 30h semanais

Additional information

  • Trabalho 100% presencial
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, 13h às 19h, 30h semanais
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço devem seguir as normativas de RH vigentes, consultando o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

  • Will bring new ideas to the sales teams for building new business and crafting additional pipelines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of channel experience or similar business-to-business quota-carrying sales. Software (sales, adoption/renewal) or cyber security experience desired.
  • Cisco sales, product & technical certifications preferred.
  • Consistent achievement of sales quotas.
  • Consistent achievement of forecasted revenue targets (i.e., achieving consistent forecast accuracy).

Preferred Qualifications

BS/BA or equivalent

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada

When available, the salary range posted for this position reflects the projected hiring range for new hire, full-time salaries in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including equity or benefits. For non-sales roles the hiring ranges reflect base salary only; employees are also eligible to receive annual bonuses. Hiring ranges for sales positions include base and incentive compensation target. Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location and additional factors, including but not limited to skillset, experience, and relevant education, certifications, or training. Applicants may not be eligible for the full salary range based on their U.S. or Canada hiring location. The recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees have access to quality medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, short and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance and numerous wellbeing offerings.

Employees receive up to twelve paid holidays per calendar year, which includes one floating holiday (for non-exempt employees), plus a day off for their birthday. Non-Exempt new hires accrue up to 16 days of vacation time off each year, at a rate of 4.92 hours per pay period. Exempt new hires participate in Cisco’s flexible Vacation Time Off policy, which does not place a defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use, but is subject to availability and some business limitations. All new hires are eligible for Sick Time Off subject to Cisco’s Sick Time Off Policy and will have eighty (80) hours of sick time off provided on their hire date and on January 1st of each year thereafter. Up to 80 hours of unused sick time will be carried forward from one calendar year to the next such that the maximum number of sick time hours an employee may have available is 160 hours. Employees in Illinois have a unique time off program designed specifically with local requirements in mind. All employees also have access to paid time away to deal with critical or emergency issues. We offer additional paid time to volunteer and give back to the community.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

title: Sustainability Manager
description:
General Description:

The Sustainability Manager will be responsible for driving the company’s sustainability strategy with a strong focus on Scope 3 emissions. This role will identify and mitigate sustainability risks, embed sustainable practices into procurement and supply chain operations, manage sustainability data and reporting, and communicate progress transparently to internal and external stakeholders. The role will report to the Head of Procurement & Sustainability Excellence.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the company’s sustainability strategy with emphasis on Scope 3 emissions reduction, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and values.
  • Manage sustainability budgets, including projects and future financial projections through 2027.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize sustainability risks and opportunities across the value chain; maintain and update climate risk mapping (e.g., Power BI dashboards based on BSI data).
  • Integrate climate-related risks into enterprise risk management (ERM) systems and mitigation plans, and ensure effective tracking and follow-up.
  • Establish and maintain accurate Scope 3 data tables, target-setting frameworks, and emissions footprint repositories.
  • Track and report supplier sustainability data to meet internal needs and external obligations (e.g., sustainability reports, Hong Kong Stock Exchange requirements).
  • Collaborate with sourcing managers (primarily direct, with some indirect) to embed Scope 3 reduction into category strategies, sourcing decisions, and implementation plans.
  • Develop and implement sustainable procurement policies, including ESG sourcing guidance, supplier evaluation criteria, and performance measurement.
  • Lead supplier engagement initiatives, including climate questionnaires, maturity assessments, outreach, and training sessions, to improve supplier performance on sustainability.
  • Support supplier development programs, including diversity, audits, partnerships, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Educate suppliers and third-party vendors on climate awareness and emissions reduction expectations.
  • Research and evaluate new sustainability technologies and trends (e.g., AI resource use, green chemistry, sustainable construction, and packaging) for business impact and adoption potential.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to procurement leadership and other stakeholders (e.g., PLT updates, ESG sourcing guidance, sustainability reports).
  • Design and deliver internal sustainability education and awareness programs, including recorded webinars and training for procurement teams.
  • Ensure compliance with evolving regulations, industry best practices, and responsible procurement due diligence requirements.
  • Build business cases for sustainability initiatives, drive organizational change, and act as a trusted advisor on sustainable business practices.

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sustainability management, with proven expertise in Scope 3 emissions.

Other Experience:

  • Strong understanding of sustainability and ESG principles, with practical application in procurement and supply chain.
  • Experience developing and implementing supplier engagement and responsible procurement programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to build compelling business cases.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive change without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience preparing clear reports and presentations for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a related regulated sector is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.

N/A

Approximately 10%

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

title: Team Lead
description:
Overview

Sunbit builds financial technology for real life. Our technology eases the stress of paying for life’s expenses by giving people more options on how and when they pay. Founded in 2016, Sunbit offers a next-generation, no-fee credit card that can be managed through a powerful mobile app, as well as a point-of-sale payment option available at more than 25,000 service locations, including auto dealership service centers, optical practices, dental offices, veterinary clinics, and specialty healthcare services. Sunbit was included on the 2022 Inc. 5000 list. The financial technology company has also been named Sunbit as a Most Loved Workplace, Best Point of Sale Company, and a Top Fintech Startup by CB Insights.

We use cutting-edge innovations in financial technology to bring leading data and features that allow individuals to be qualified instantly, making purchases at the point-of-sale fast, fair, and easy for consumers from all walks of life. We create value focused on our core values; we work tirelessly to ensure that Sunbit becomes available to everyone, everywhere.

We invite you to #UnleashyourCuriosity and join our ever-growing R&D organization.

What You’ll Do

As the Team Lead of the Account Management squad , you will guide a multidisciplinary team of backend and data engineers responsible for some of Sunbit’s most critical financial operations. Your mission is to build and scale the systems that keep our loan and card processes accurate, transparent, and resilient — while fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and technical excellence within the squad.

In this role, you’ll not only manage talented engineers but also work closely with finance, risk, product, and compliance stakeholders to ensure our technology delivers real business impact. Your team’s scope includes payment allocation, disbursement management, and the delivery of loan and card performance data products that support both internal decision-making and external reporting across regulators, partners, and investors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing squad of backend and data engineers.
  • Own and evolve Sunbit’s loan account management systems and data products.
  • Ensure accuracy and automation in payment allocation and manage disbursement flows.
  • Deliver high-quality Loan Performance and Card Performance data products used across internal operations, executive dashboards, and external reporting.
  • Build scalable, reliable systems that support high transaction volumes with full financial integrity.
  • Partner with finance, risk, product, and compliance to align technology with business goals.

Requirements

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 10+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on software system architecture.
  • 4+ years of experience leading engineering teams and managing end-to-end project lifecycles.
  • Strong background in building large-scale, high-performance financial or transactional systems.
  • Experience with data pipelines, big data infrastructure, microservices architecture, and message bus.
  • Hands-on experience with Java and Python, and modern cloud technologies.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across engineering, finance, risk, and product stakeholders.
  • Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.

Advantages

  • Working knowledge of Kotlin.
  • Prior experience in fintech or payment systems.
  • Familiarity with loan and card performance data products and internal/external reporting use cases.

Why Join Us

Join Sunbit at the core of our financial operations, leading the squad that ensures loan and card performance data products, disbursement management, and payment allocation systems are accurate, resilient, and scalable. Your leadership will shape both the technology and the people who build it, powering Sunbit’s growth and setting the standard for modern financial operations.

Overview

We’re looking for a UX Designer (Remote) candidate that resides in Brazil.

The UX Designer will play a key role in delivering high-quality, user-focused design solutions that support sales, marketing, and purchasing initiatives. This position is responsible for creating intuitive, engaging digital experiences and contributing visually compelling assets that align with brand objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in UX principles and visual design, leveraging user research, wireframes, and prototyping to improve interfaces and optimize user journeys. They will collaborate across departments to deliver purposeful, innovative design solutions that elevate both function and form reporting to the Creative Director.

Important: While this role is open to candidates across any location in Brazil, High Tide brands do not operate or market in Brazil. This role will support our global markets in North America and Europe.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the creation of user-centered, visually engaging design strategies that enhance customer engagement and brand connection across digital platforms.
  • Translate complex concepts into clean, elegant user experiences through intuitive flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and competitive audits to uncover insights that inform visual design decisions.
  • Design user journeys, personas, and sitemaps that bring clarity and intention to navigation and structure.
  • Apply responsive and accessible design principles to ensure seamless experiences across all devices and audiences.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure design intent is maintained in final implementation—no coding is required.
  • Use design analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Google Analytics) to evaluate user engagement and optimize visual UX outcomes.
  • Stay current with design trends, emerging tools, and UX best practices to continuously elevate digital design standards.

Web Design Responsibilities

  • Design aesthetically refined, responsive websites and digital experiences that reflect brand identity and drive user engagement.
  • Craft visually dynamic layouts, landing pages, and UI components with a focus on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling.
  • Work closely with marketing, e-commerce, and content teams to align design with strategic goals, user needs, and brand tone.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and brand style guides to ensure consistency and scalability across all touchpoints.
  • Design complementary digital assets such as banners, email templates, promotional graphics, and pop-ups that support campaign objectives.
  • Provide design QA during handoff and development phases to uphold visual quality and ensure design consistency.

Organizational & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contribute to a creative and collaborative team environment by participating in critiques, brainstorming sessions, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Manage multiple design projects with efficiency, consistently meeting deadlines while maintaining attention to visual and UX detail.
  • Maintain organized, well-labeled design files and ensure work is version-controlled and accessible across shared platforms.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Education:

  • 3 – 4-year Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, or a related visual design discipline.

Skills & Experience:

  • 3 – 5 years of experience in UX and visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing modern, clean, and user-focused work across web, mobile, and email.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), Figma, and Mac-based design workflows.
  • Expertise in user experience design principles, user interface best practices, and visual storytelling across digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo) and design standards for high-performance email campaigns.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present design concepts and rationale to diverse stakeholders.
  • Collaborative spirit, visual creativity, and a passion for delivering design that delights users and drives results.

Why Join High Tide

  • Be part of one of the largest global cannabis and accessories companies.
  • Join a collaborative, team that values speed, ownership, and creativity.
  • Fully remote role with flexibility and meaningful impact.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit:

  • Yourresume in English.
  • (Optional) Any relevant portfolio or example campaigns that reflect your expertise and experience.

About Us

High Tide Inc. is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count⁷ . High Tide (HITI) is uniquely-built around the cannabis consumer, with wholly-diversified and fully-integrated operations across all components of cannabis, including:

  • Bricks & Mortar Retail: Canna Cabana is the largest cannabis retail chain in Canada, with 200 plus current locations spanning British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and growing. In 2021, Canna Cabana became the first cannabis discount club retailer in the world.
  • Retail Innovation: Fastendr is a unique and fully automated technology that employs retail kiosks to facilitate a better buying experience through browsing, ordering and pickup.
  • Consumption Accessories: High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory e-commerce platforms across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.
  • E-commerce Platforms: High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory sites across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.

CBD: High Tide continues to cultivate the possibilities of consumer CBD through Nuleafnaturals.com, FABCBD.com, blessedcbd.de and blessedcbd.co.uk.

Wholesale Distribution: High Tide keeps that cannabis category stocked with wholesale solutions via Valiant.

Licensing: High Tide continues to push cannabis culture forward through fresh partnerships and license agreements under the Famous Brandz name.

High Tide consistently moves ahead of the currents, having been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 by the Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine, and was named as one of the top 10 performing diversified industries stocks in both 2022 and 2024 TSX Venture 50. About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

What We Do:

Huntress is a fully remote, global team of passionate experts and ethical badasses on a mission to break down the barriers to cybersecurity. Whether creating purpose-built security solutions, hunting down hackers, or impacting our community, our people go above and beyond to change the security game and make a real difference.

The Huntress difference is our One Team advantage: our technology is designed with our industry-defining Security Operations Center (SOC) in mind and is never separated from our service.

Huntress is looking to expand its post-sale reach by building its first Customer Success team. O time de CRM é responsável pela diagramação e validação de e-mails responsivos em HTML, configurar disparos em ferramentas de automação de marketing, definir e criar segmentações para envios, além de participar do processo de planejamento estratégico para clientes, criando e fazendo a manutenção de réguas de e-mail. Tudo isso acompanhado da análise de resultados e KPI's, para apresentação de resultados e sugestões de melhorias nos diversos processos relacionados à área através de relatórios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Criação e ajustes de templates de email responsivos em HTML;
  • Criação e manutenção de segmentações para envio, com base nos dados existentes na plataforma de CRM;
  • Criação e agendamento de disparos pontuais de Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Criação e manutenção de réguas / jornadas / fluxos automáticos de comunicação com Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Mensuração de resultados das campanhas, análise de KPIs como taxas de entrega, abertura, cliques e conversão, dentre outras. Capacidade de tirar insights destes resultados para propor melhorias e otimização na operação em andamento;
  • Suporte estratégico junto ao cliente, para identificar pontos que podem ser ajustados e melhorados na estratégia proposta.

Ferramentas e metodologias

  • Plataformas de automação de marketing e CRM, tais como Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Hubspot, entre outras;
  • Ferramentas do Google como Sheets, Slides e Docs;
  • Ferramentas de comunicação interna como Slack e Google Chat;
  • Metodologias ágeis.

O que poderá ser aprendido e/ou desenvolvido

  • Estratégias de CRM e personalização de comunicação com os clientes;
  • Gestão de campanhas de marketing digital e contato com outras áreas correlacionadas;
  • Especialização técnica na plataforma do projeto no qual for alocado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência e proficiência em HTML para e-mails;
  • Conhecimento em Google Analytics;

  • Experiência em análise de resultados das campanhas de CRM: Saber analisar KPIs operacionais como taxas de entrega, abertura e cliques, bem como resultados financeiros como taxa de conversão e atingimento de metas;

  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO NEONATAL que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes (CIPA), Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da sua equipe de enfermagem orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão leito a leito, passando ou recebendo os pacientes, com os prontuários em ordem: impressos identificados, medicação verificada, artigos com data de trocas em dia, exames realizados e anotações claras, conferência de materiais do setor e expurgo limpo e organizado;
  • Realizar a cada plantão, registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe presente, preenchendo o checklist (materiais permanentes e controle de pacientes), anotando as intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e garantir a abertura das Notificações do NSP;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE);
  • Realizar visitas aos pacientes em todo plantão, priorizando pelo seu grau de dependência, avaliando-os através de exame físico e observação constante, anotando na SAE e garantindo a qualidade da assistência prestada;
  • Avaliar os pacientes utilizando os indicadores adotados pela instituição (Braden Q e Escala Hupty Dumpty);
  • Encaminhar corretamente o paciente ao Centro Cirúrgico e preencher o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória (SAEP);
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar corretamente a identificação do paciente;
  • Carimbar e assinar qualquer evolução e/ou registro realizado, na ausência do carimbo, escrever o nome todo por extenso com o número do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Assistir ao paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas afetadas, promovendo condições adequadas para seu repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar os procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro, como os curativos com drenos ou infectados, curativos de úlcera por pressão (preenchendo o controle de feridas), curativos de acesso profundo, cateterismos vesical, sondagem vesical, nasogástrica e nasoentérico, não podendo ser delegado aos técnicos, lembrando-se de registrar tudo corretamente na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada, observando que sejam obedecidos todos os cuidados;
  • Preparar e instalar os drippings dos pacientes, delegando essa função à equipe técnica somente na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar aos setores responsáveis, pedido de exames e autorização de materiais especiais, devidamente protocolados;
  • Informar ao médico assistente, as intercorrências que venham a ocorrer com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • 1 ano de experiência na função
